summary: Neri-owned investigations, evidence, and target metadata.

help:
Usage: neri [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Read and maintain Neri targets, investigations, notes, reports and
  disclosure programs

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  investigations
  create           Create a saved attempt through the legacy...
  show
  activity
  record-activity
  context
  capabilities
  reports
  control
  operation
  evidence         Import evidence and inspect retained artifacts
  notes            Save contextual notes and direction
  report           Read exact report and review revisions, save reports...
  execute          Submit explicit typed actions to a registered local...
  target           Inspect and maintain registered target metadata
  group            Read and organize passive investigations containing...
  program          Maintain passive disclosure programs and exact policy...
  runtime          Inspect or operate Neri's emergency admission stop
  research         Read research capability progress and save exact...
  worker           Inspect the bounded local candidate and Neri-owned...
  jev              Run typed Jev evaluations through Agent Hub

usage.cmd: st neri investigations [--limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: list saved Neri attempts using the legacy investigation contract
precautions: read-only; IDs identify runs, not passive groups; next_cursor resumes the saved listing

usage.cmd: st neri create --file investigation.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save an attempt with title, objective, scope and optional group membership
precautions: passive creation; preserve group_id and role when supplied; JSON id or --id is retained, otherwise generated and printed; reuse only for identical content

usage.cmd: st neri show <investigation-id>
usage.when: inspect a saved investigation
precautions: read-only; saved state does not imply external terminal execution was observed

usage.cmd: st neri activity <investigation-id> [--after 0 --limit 40]
usage.when: read a page of retained investigation activity
precautions: read-only; resume using the returned event sequence

usage.cmd: st neri record-activity <investigation-id> --file activity.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: record a public objective, hypothesis, decision, progress update, blocker or follow-up
precautions: passive record only; cite exact evidence and SummitFlow task IDs; private chain-of-thought does not belong here; UUID is retained or generated

usage.cmd: st neri context <investigation-id> [--after 0 --limit 40 --research-digest SHA256]
usage.when: load compact local investigation state, evidence references and independently invalidated research guidance
precautions: read-only local projection; retrieval is not proof of model consumption

usage.cmd: st neri capabilities [--full]
usage.when: discover Neri API payload contracts
precautions: read-only; compact output omits schemas and --full returns every payload schema

usage.cmd: st neri reports [--view investigations --target TARGET --limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: list saved attempt reports or explicitly selected investigation reports
precautions: read-only; default retains run-valued investigation_id; investigations view preserves group, run and exact report/review IDs; next_cursor resumes the listing

usage.cmd: st neri control <investigation-id> pause|stop
usage.when: pause or stop a Neri-managed operation
precautions: in-flight work may finish; external terminals remain under their own control

usage.cmd: st neri operation <investigation-id> <operation-id>
usage.when: inspect a retained managed-operation result
precautions: read-only; queued status is not completion evidence

usage.cmd: st neri evidence list <investigation-id> [--after 0 --limit 40]
usage.when: list a page of retained evidence references
precautions: read-only; resume with through_seq while has_more; preserve provenance and completeness

usage.cmd: st neri evidence show <investigation-id> <evidence-id>
usage.when: inspect retained evidence detail
precautions: read-only; ID accepts UUID, E<number>, or operation:<UUID>; imported evidence is not automatically independently verified

usage.cmd: st neri evidence import <investigation-id> --file evidence.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: import an actual external capture with provenance
precautions: JSON object or stdin; preserve provenance and completeness; UUID is retained or generated and printed

usage.cmd: st neri evidence artifact <investigation-id> <evidence-id>
usage.when: inspect artifact metadata and its download URL
precautions: read-only; ID accepts UUID, E<number>, or operation:<UUID>; does not print artifact bytes

usage.cmd: st neri evidence download <investigation-id> <evidence-id> --output PATH
usage.when: save retained artifact bytes to a new local file
precautions: ID accepts UUID, E<number>, or operation:<UUID>; does not overwrite files; download stays on the configured Neri API

usage.cmd: st neri notes list <investigation-id>
usage.when: read saved investigation notes and direction
precautions: read-only; notes retain their context and state

usage.cmd: st neri notes add <investigation-id> --file note.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save direction or a note linked to investigation activity, evidence or report
precautions: JSON object or stdin; UUID is retained or generated and printed; saving direction does not run an agent

usage.cmd: st neri notes state <investigation-id> <note-id> acknowledged|resolved [--id UUID]
usage.when: acknowledge or resolve a saved note
precautions: state mutation UUID is retained or generated and printed; no automatic retry

usage.cmd: st neri report show <investigation-id>
usage.when: read a saved report and its reviews
precautions: read-only; retain caveats and evidence references

usage.cmd: st neri report revision <investigation-id> <revision-id>
usage.when: read one immutable report revision
precautions: read-only; fetches only the cited revision; retain caveats and evidence references

usage.cmd: st neri report review-revision <investigation-id> <revision-id>
usage.when: read one immutable review revision
precautions: read-only; fetches only the cited revision; preserve its report_revision_id and objections

usage.cmd: st neri report impact-checks <investigation-id> [--status STATUS --effect-class CLASS --offset 0 --limit 40]
usage.when: list compact material-change impact checks
precautions: read-only; a check does not expand scope, authority or executor permissions

usage.cmd: st neri report impact-check <investigation-id> <check-id>
usage.when: read one exact impact check and its owner decision
precautions: read-only; preserve exact fact, program, scope, risk and stop-condition refs

usage.cmd: st neri report record-impact-check <investigation-id> --file check.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: record a proposed action whose effects, risk, authority or claim materially changes
precautions: passive record only; it does not dispatch work or grant target authority
bind exact supported facts and current program/scope revisions

usage.cmd: st neri report decide-impact-check <investigation-id> <check-id> --file decision.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: record the owner decision for one exact impact check
precautions: append-only decision; does not dispatch the proposed action

usage.cmd: st neri report duplicate-dossiers <investigation-id> [--confidence LEVEL --report-revision-id UUID --finding-id ID --offset 0 --limit 40]
usage.when: list compact passive duplicate-research dossiers
precautions: read-only; categorical confidence never decides validity or submission

usage.cmd: st neri report duplicate-dossier <investigation-id> <dossier-id>
usage.when: read one exact passive duplicate dossier
precautions: read-only; sources and searches are public unauthenticated research

usage.cmd: st neri report record-duplicate-dossier <investigation-id> --file dossier.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: record exact dated public duplicate research for one report finding
precautions: passive record only; never access authenticated platforms through this workflow
confidence is unknown, elevated or observed; do not provide a probability

usage.cmd: st neri report save <investigation-id> --file report.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save a report revision based on retained evidence
precautions: JSON object or stdin; UUID is retained or generated and printed; does not submit reports externally

usage.cmd: st neri report review <investigation-id> --file review.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: record an independent review of a specific report revision
precautions: preserve report_revision_id, objections and actual verification attempts; UUID is retained or generated and printed

usage.cmd: st neri report download <investigation-id> --output PATH [--revision UUID --review UUID]
usage.when: download a saved report draft or exact report/review pair
precautions: omit both selectors for the latest report; --review selects its bound report; supplying both pins the exact pair and mismatches are rejected; writes a new local file; no external submission

usage.cmd: st neri report severity list <investigation-id> <revision-id> [--limit 40 --before-sequence N]
usage.when: read immutable severity assessment history for an exact report revision
precautions: read-only; preserve authority, scheme, native values and next_before_sequence; pass next_before_sequence to continue history

usage.cmd: st neri report severity show <investigation-id> <revision-id> <assessment-id>
usage.when: read one immutable severity assessment for an exact report revision
precautions: read-only; preserve the assessment identity and source; no fallback to another assessment or report revision

usage.cmd: st neri report severity save <investigation-id> <revision-id> --file assessment.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save an attributed severity assessment for an exact report revision
precautions: JSON object or stdin; preserve authority, scheme, native values, rationale and source; id is retained or generated and printed; server validates assessment fields; no automatic retry

usage.cmd: st neri execute operation <investigation-id> --file operation.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: submit one explicit HTTP or browser action to a run-pinned registered local target
precautions: target action; include current agent controller identity; no automatic retry; inspect the same operation UUID after an uncertain response

usage.cmd: st neri execute external-http <investigation-id> --file request.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: submit one explicitly bounded HTTP request through an external-http target manifest
precautions: target action; requires current program scope, admission grant and exact controller identity
no automatic retry after uncertain transport; retain the request UUID and receipt
redirects, credentials, authority headers, private destinations and out-of-budget requests are rejected

usage.cmd: st neri execute runtime <investigation-id>
usage.when: read the sanitized runner release and target-state identity for an exact workbench investigation
precautions: read-only runner identity; does not grant target authority or establish target reachability
record the observed release before freezing a campaign or replay configuration

usage.cmd: st neri execute runtime-snapshot <investigation-id> --file snapshot.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: retain a server-observed runner release and target-generation identity
precautions: include the current controller identity; this records runtime identity but performs no target action
use the retained event identity in a prospective catalog plan or campaign registration

usage.cmd: st neri execute sequence <investigation-id> --file sequence.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: submit a finite prepared action sequence to a run-pinned registered local target
precautions: target actions; use only when intermediate judgment is unnecessary; include current controller identity; no automatic retry; inspect the same UUID after uncertainty

usage.cmd: st neri execute reset <investigation-id> --file reset.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: recreate the exact run-pinned local target from its registered clean state
precautions: target mutation; global stop and a settled run are required; bind expected_target_manifest_digest; reconcile the same UUID after uncertainty

usage.cmd: st neri target list [--workspace --limit 40 --cursor TOKEN --search TEXT --filter FILTER]
usage.when: list compact manifests or logical target workspace summaries
precautions: read-only; default preserves registered manifest metadata; workspace uses filter-bound cursors and bounded summaries

usage.cmd: st neri target show <target-id> [--workspace]
usage.when: read a target manifest or its compact workspace context
precautions: read-only; default preserves the manifest and digest; read workspace context before exact attempts

usage.cmd: st neri target register --file target.json
usage.when: register target metadata through Neri
precautions: JSON object or stdin; records metadata only; API validates boundaries and version identity

usage.cmd: st neri target status <target-id> --file status.json
usage.when: update a registered target's active status
precautions: preserve manifest_digest, expected_status, status and reason; conflicts are not retried

usage.cmd: st neri target notes list <target-id> [--state saved|acknowledged|resolved --limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read a page of target direction notes
precautions: read-only; previews may truncate bodies; preserve note IDs and next_cursor

usage.cmd: st neri target notes add <target-id> --file note.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save target direction with exact saved context references
precautions: JSON object or stdin; id is retained or generated and printed; preserve run/event/evidence/report/review references; passive notes do not imply delivery or execution

usage.cmd: st neri target notes show <target-id> <note-id>
usage.when: read one target direction note with its full body and context
precautions: read-only; uses the exact note ID without falling back to a preview

usage.cmd: st neri target notes history <target-id> <note-id> [--limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read immutable target note state transitions
precautions: read-only; preserve state_revision_id, mutation_id, revision and next_cursor

usage.cmd: st neri target notes state <target-id> <note-id> --file state.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: acknowledge, resolve or reopen target direction
precautions: JSON includes expected_revision, state and reason; --id identifies mutation_id; retained or generated ID is printed; same-state writes and stale revisions are rejected; no automatic retry

usage.cmd: st neri target programs list <target-id> [--manifest-id UUID --environment NAME --include-history --limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read current target program applicability bindings or their revision history
precautions: read-only; manifest and environment filters are exact; list previews omit full policy; preserve binding and binding revision IDs

usage.cmd: st neri target programs bind <target-id> --file binding.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save or revise exact target program applicability
precautions: JSON preserves program_revision_id, manifest_id, environment and optional run/report/finding IDs; include expected_revision; target_scope_status and eligibility_status are separate; id identifies the immutable binding revision and is retained or generated; no automatic retry

usage.cmd: st neri target programs show <target-id> <binding-id> [--revision-id UUID]
usage.when: read full current or exact immutable binding detail and its pinned policy
precautions: read-only; --revision-id pins an immutable binding revision; binding identity is distinct from its revision ID; no fallback

usage.cmd: st neri target programs history <target-id> <binding-id> [--limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read immutable revisions of one exact applicability binding
precautions: read-only; history omits full policy; preserve supersedes_revision_id and next_cursor

usage.cmd: st neri group list <target-id> [--limit 40 --cursor TOKEN --search TEXT --class-key KEY --filter FILTER --include-empty]
usage.when: list passive investigations for a logical target
precautions: read-only; filters apply before pagination; preserve group IDs and section continuation cursors; empty historical groups are omitted unless requested

usage.cmd: st neri group create <target-id> --file group.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save a sustained investigation before assigning attempts
precautions: passive grouping only; JSON id or --id identifies the group and is retained or generated; reuse only for identical content

usage.cmd: st neri group show <target-id> <group-id> [--limit 40 --cursor TOKEN --report-limit 40 --report-cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read compact investigation context with paginated attempts and report history
precautions: read-only; limit/cursor apply to attempts; report pagination is independent; preserve membership, selection and exact report/review IDs; no selection is a valid state

usage.cmd: st neri group classify <target-id> <group-id> --file classification.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: revise an investigation's primary class metadata
precautions: preserve expected_revision, class_key, class_label and reason; --id identifies mutation_id; conflicts are not retried

usage.cmd: st neri group select-report <target-id> <group-id> --file selection.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: select or explicitly clear an exact investigation report
precautions: preserve expected_revision and reason; report_revision_id null clears selection; --id identifies mutation_id; newer reports never replace the selection automatically

usage.cmd: st neri group membership <target-id> <group-id> --file membership.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: assign or reassign an attempt to a passive investigation
precautions: preserve run_id, expected_revision, role, exact predecessor/report references and reason; --id identifies mutation_id; clear a selected report before moving its owner run; no automatic retry

usage.cmd: st neri group notes list <target-id> <group-id> [--state saved|acknowledged|resolved --limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read a page of passive investigation direction notes
precautions: read-only; group IDs are distinct from run IDs; previews may truncate bodies; preserve next_cursor

usage.cmd: st neri group notes add <target-id> <group-id> --file note.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save passive investigation direction with exact saved context references
precautions: JSON object or stdin; id is retained or generated and printed; context survives reassignment; passive notes do not imply delivery, execution or blockers

usage.cmd: st neri group notes show <target-id> <group-id> <note-id>
usage.when: read one investigation direction note with its full body and context
precautions: read-only; preserves the exact group, note and contextual record IDs

usage.cmd: st neri group notes history <target-id> <group-id> <note-id> [--limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read immutable investigation note state transitions
precautions: read-only; preserve state_revision_id, mutation_id, revision and next_cursor

usage.cmd: st neri group notes state <target-id> <group-id> <note-id> --file state.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: acknowledge, resolve or reopen investigation direction
precautions: JSON includes expected_revision, state and reason; --id identifies mutation_id; retained or generated ID is printed; same-state writes and stale revisions are rejected; no automatic retry

usage.cmd: st neri program list [--limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read saved disclosure program identities
precautions: read-only; program identity is distinct from its immutable policy revisions; preserve next_cursor

usage.cmd: st neri program create --file program.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save a named disclosure program identity
precautions: JSON object or stdin; id is retained or generated and printed; passive record only; policy is saved separately as a revision

usage.cmd: st neri program show <program-id>
usage.when: read one disclosure program identity and its current revision reference
precautions: read-only; fetch the exact policy revision separately

usage.cmd: st neri program revisions <program-id> [--limit 40 --cursor TOKEN]
usage.when: read a page of immutable disclosure policy revision summaries
precautions: read-only; summaries omit policy_snapshot and may truncate summary; use revision for exact detail

usage.cmd: st neri program revise <program-id> --file revision.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save an immutable disclosure policy snapshot and sources
precautions: JSON includes expected_revision, policy_snapshot and sources; verification fields record manually supplied facts; id is retained or generated and printed; policy revisions never rewrite bindings; no automatic retry

usage.cmd: st neri program revision <program-id> <revision-id>
usage.when: read one full immutable disclosure policy revision
precautions: read-only; exact revision ID is preserved; no fallback to the current policy

usage.cmd: st neri runtime show
usage.when: inspect the Neri emergency admission stop and revision
precautions: read-only; external terminals remain under their own control

usage.cmd: st neri runtime stop
usage.when: hold new Neri-managed work and request cancellation of owned work
precautions: submitted work may finish; does not stop external terminals; stale stop revisions are accepted

usage.cmd: st neri runtime release --revision N
usage.when: release emergency admission stop using its observed revision
precautions: no conflict retry; releasing admission does not resume existing operations

usage.cmd: st neri research catalogue [--full]
usage.when: read versioned research capability definitions
precautions: definitions are assessment metadata; draft or active state is explicit and grants no target authority

usage.cmd: st neri research application-models <investigation-id>
usage.when: list compact cited application-model snapshots for one investigation
precautions: read-only; candidate claims remain distinct from observed claims and gaps

usage.cmd: st neri research application-model-current <investigation-id>
usage.when: read the newest exact cited application-model snapshot
precautions: read-only; newest means retained snapshot order, not universal target truth

usage.cmd: st neri research application-model <investigation-id> <snapshot-id>
usage.when: read one exact cited application-model snapshot
precautions: read-only; preserve exact source, program, manifest, claim-state and gap refs

usage.cmd: st neri research save-application-model <investigation-id> --file snapshot.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save one append-only cited application model for an exact run and scope binding
precautions: passive record only; does not grant authority or execute target actions
candidate, observed and gap states require exact cited sources

usage.cmd: st neri research show <capability-id> [--version VERSION]
usage.when: read one exact research capability revision
precautions: read-only definition; required tools and prerequisites must still be established

usage.cmd: st neri research case-schema <capability-id> [--version VERSION]
usage.when: read only the inputs, controls and safety rules needed to prepare one capability case
precautions: read-only method contract; it grants no target authority

usage.cmd: st neri research matrix [--full --capability ID --offset 0 --limit 20]
usage.when: read technical evidence, implementation readiness and commercial outcomes
precautions: projection is evidence-derived; inspect denominators, counterevidence and contamination

usage.cmd: st neri research context <investigation-id> [--previous-digest SHA256]
usage.when: read independently invalidated research guidance for an investigation
precautions: read-only guidance; unchanged means the exact research input digest did not change

usage.cmd: st neri research recommend <investigation-id>
usage.when: read deterministic capability guidance
precautions: does not call a model, write state, grant authority or perform target interaction

usage.cmd: st neri research links <investigation-id>
usage.when: read immutable capability selections and evidence associations
precautions: technical verdicts remain owned by exact reviews

usage.cmd: st neri research associate <investigation-id> --file association.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save a prospective selection or exact reviewed evidence association
precautions: JSON or stdin; selection must precede all result evidence for prospective credit; no verdict is accepted here

usage.cmd: st neri research prepare-case <investigation-id> --file case.json
usage.when: derive and save a prospective capability selection from a compact case description
precautions: server derives target build, environment, required tools, safety digest and configuration digest; a needs_input response writes no selection

usage.cmd: st neri research associate-case <investigation-id> <selection-id> --file result.json
usage.when: bind an exact report, review and controls to a prospective capability selection
precautions: server copies immutable selection identity; the report and review remain authoritative for the verdict

usage.cmd: st neri research invalidate-case <investigation-id> <selection-id> --file closeout.json
usage.when: close a prospective case whose tooling, evidence, scope or authorization became unsuitable
precautions: does not create method counterevidence or erase saved history; use a reviewed result for actual method outcomes

usage.cmd: st neri research snapshot <investigation-id> --file snapshot.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save the exact deterministic recommendation and input digest
precautions: server rejects stale input digests; saving does not dispatch work

usage.cmd: st neri research snapshots <investigation-id>
usage.when: read saved deterministic recommendation history
precautions: bounded read-only history; preserve input and source digests

usage.cmd: st neri research outcomes <investigation-id>
usage.when: read immutable commercial outcome history
precautions: owner-confirmed program/report attribution only; technical support remains in reviews

usage.cmd: st neri research record-outcome <investigation-id> --file outcome.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: append an owner-confirmed commercial status
precautions: requires exact report, finding and program binding revisions; never infers acceptance or payment

usage.cmd: st neri research cohorts
usage.when: read prospective fixed-denominator evaluation cohorts and economics
precautions: read-only; observed margin is not a statistical guarantee of future profit
unknown cost or human time blocks a complete economics claim

usage.cmd: st neri research cohort <cohort-id>
usage.when: inspect one exact cohort, case denominator, work receipts, closure and economics
precautions: read-only; preserve exact program, capability and configuration identities

usage.cmd: st neri research register-cohort --file cohort.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: freeze a prospective evaluation before result-generating work
precautions: requires exact current program scope, target build, capability/configuration and cases
new opportunities or material configuration changes require a successor cohort

usage.cmd: st neri research catalog-campaigns [--full --status STATUS --offset 0 --limit 20]
usage.when: list frozen owned-lab catalog campaigns and their derived completion state
precautions: read-only; campaign completion requires every item and an exact cumulative replay

usage.cmd: st neri research catalog-campaign <campaign-id> [--full --item-status STATUS --offset 0 --limit 40]
usage.when: inspect one frozen catalog denominator, item results and cumulative replay
precautions: read-only; preserve exact target, source, configuration and review identities

usage.cmd: st neri research register-catalog-campaign --file campaign.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: freeze an exact owned-lab catalog denominator before result-generating work
precautions: bind the exact target build, source digests, runner, reset procedure and policy/configuration
a material identity or workflow change requires a successor campaign

usage.cmd: st neri research record-catalog-plan <campaign-id> --file plan.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: persist a batch technique, clean setup and controls before catalog result evidence
precautions: the plan must cite a server-observed runtime snapshot and exact frozen item keys
record the plan before dispatching any result-generating operation

usage.cmd: st neri research verify-catalog-item <campaign-id> <item-key> --file result.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: append one catalog item's exact evidence-backed independently reviewed completion
precautions: requires authoritative solve, clean setup, controls, reproduction, report and supported review references
a status code, page appearance or model answer alone is not completion

usage.cmd: st neri research record-catalog-replay <campaign-id> --file replay.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: append the independently reviewed clean cumulative replay for an exact catalog denominator
precautions: the replay must cover exactly every frozen item and cite authoritative final solved-state evidence
recording a replay never repairs incomplete individual item evidence

usage.cmd: st neri research close-cohort <cohort-id> --file closure.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: append the one outcome-independent closure assessment for a frozen cohort
precautions: must retain every registered case and frozen coverage item
closure never authorizes submission or infers finding validity/payment

usage.cmd: st neri research finalize-accounting <cohort-id> --file accounting.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: freeze the commercial measurement cutoff after research and later handling finish
precautions: research closure must already exist; retain every registered case
complete accounting requires exact final outcomes and known time/direct costs
later payments or costs do not rewrite this immutable as-of measurement

usage.cmd: st neri research work <investigation-id>
usage.when: read immutable research work receipts for an investigation
precautions: read-only; zero and unknown measurements have distinct meanings

usage.cmd: st neri research record-work <investigation-id> --file receipt.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: append measured agent, tool and owner work to a prospective cohort
precautions: requires exact cohort/case/configuration and evidence references
never coerce missing time, token usage or direct cost to zero

usage.cmd: st neri research application <investigation-id>
usage.when: inspect the experimental passive application-evidence projection
precautions: read-only; static candidates do not establish reachability or vulnerability
projection executes no JavaScript, follows no links and calls no model

usage.cmd: st neri research application-snapshots <investigation-id>
usage.when: read immutable application-evidence snapshot history
precautions: read-only; preserve source and build identities

usage.cmd: st neri research snapshot-application <investigation-id> --file snapshot.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: freeze the current exact application-evidence source projection
precautions: server rejects a stale source digest
saving a projection performs no target interaction and grants no capability credit

usage.cmd: st neri worker status
usage.when: verify the exact local Neri candidate runtime before assigning passive work

usage.cmd: st neri worker evaluate --task-family FAMILY --file packet.json [--arm ARM]
usage.when: delegate a sanitized passive evidence task to an evidence-qualified local worker
precautions: Packet must contain only sanitized objective/evidence/constraints; output is an unreviewed draft

usage.cmd: st neri worker benchmark --split development|locked [--arm ARM] [--case-id ID] [--runs N] [--study-id ID --study-block N --study-case-position N --study-replacement N]
usage.when: compare model-alone and model-plus-harness behavior before routing any task family
precautions: Locked cases are promotion evidence; never tune the harness against their answers
Study mode is frozen; attempts are durable one case at a time and outputs are unreviewed
Study replacements preserve originals and label a full block; they never enable selective case reruns

usage.cmd: st neri worker qualification [--task-family FAMILY]
usage.when: read the durable Neri promotion decision and evidence summary before assigning local work
precautions: A held or missing family remains on its established frontier-model route
Qualification state grants no target authority and does not make the local worker a reviewer

usage.cmd: st neri worker qualify --file decision.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: append an independently reviewed qualification decision to Neri
precautions: The JSON must cite the exact immutable benchmark and review evidence
Decisions are append-only; a promotion never grants scope or submission authority

usage.cmd: st neri worker shadow <run-id> --file assignment.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: save a passive local-worker shadow assignment before its draft exists
precautions: Use only a sanitized referenced packet; the local worker gets no target, tool, memory, or network authority
The positional run is authoritative and a contradictory JSON run_id is rejected

usage.cmd: st neri worker assignments [--run-id UUID] [--task-family FAMILY]
usage.when: list saved local-worker shadow assignments and their current review disposition
precautions: Read-only; assignment IDs are server-issued and identify exact retained drafts

usage.cmd: st neri worker assignment <assignment-id>
usage.when: read one exact saved shadow assignment, draft provenance, and review disposition
precautions: Read-only; a retained draft remains inert until a frontier review accepts it

usage.cmd: st neri worker review <run-id> <assignment-id> --file review.json [--id UUID]
usage.when: append a frontier review and exact corrections for one local-worker shadow draft
precautions: The reviewer must verify every reference, supported inference, and uncertainty
Reviews are immutable; acceptance records draft usefulness but grants no broad family promotion

usage.cmd: st neri jev evaluate --file request.json [--dry-run]
usage.when: submit one typed Jev evaluation request through Agent Hub
precautions: Use --dry-run to validate the exact request contract and preview its reservation without provider dispatch
